ownerHome.title: Dashboard
ownerHome.description: Overview of properties, pipeline and money.
ownerHome.emptyDescription: Create your first property to start the pipeline.

auth.signInDescription: Use the email and password your owner gave you.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.inboxDescription: Everything sent to you. Pushes and inbox are mirrors of the same record.
notifications.emptyDescription: When something is assigned, accepted, or rejected, it'll land here.

installCard.title: Get notified the moment work is ready
installCard.description: Install this app and enable notifications so you don’t miss assigned tasks or acceptance updates. Your inbox keeps a copy of everything regardless.
installCard.iosInstructions: On iPhone/iPad: tap Share, then ‘Add to Home Screen’.
installCard.installUnavailable: Install prompt isn’t available right now. Try again later.

invite.consumedBody: This invitation link has already been redeemed. If this was you, try signing in. Otherwise ask the owner to send a new invitation.
invite.expiredBody: This invitation link has expired. Ask the owner to send a new invitation.

properties.title: Properties
properties.description: Units in the pipeline. Each property snapshots the company's default template at creation.
properties.emptyDescription: Create your first property to start the pipeline.
properties.emptyFilteredDescription: Try clearing the filter or search.

propertyDetail.awaitingInspector: Awaiting Sub-stage 1.1 (Initial Property Acceptance) by an Inspector. The first master stage will unlock once 1.1 is accepted.
propertyDetail.archiveDialogDesc: Archives this unfinished property. Material issuances will be blocked. You can un-archive it later — the audit record below preserves the reason.
propertyDetail.archiveReasonPlaceholder: e.g. client cancelled, scope change, duplicate
propertyDetail.archiveBlockedDesc: Finish, reject, or wait on these sub-stages before archiving:

propertyFinance.title: {{name}} — finance
propertyFinance.materialsIncomplete: Materials estimate incomplete — issue materials from the warehouse to make Actual accurate.
propertyFinance.readyToCloseDesc: All master stages accepted. Run the final audit to archive the property and generate the handover certificate.

warehouse.title: Warehouse
warehouse.description: Materials your team uses on properties. Issuances decrement stock and write material costs against properties automatically.
warehouse.emptyDescription: Add your first material to start tracking inventory.
warehouse.addMaterialDesc: Pick a unit, set the current price, optionally record an opening balance.
warehouse.archiveConfirmDesc: The material will no longer appear in lists or new issuances. Its movement history is preserved.
warehouse.archiveBlockedStock: Cannot archive a material with stock on hand. Adjust stock to zero first.
warehouse.issueDesc: Pick materials and quantities. Each line writes a material cost against the property at the current unit price.

folders.emptyFolderDescription: Add a material to this folder, or pick another folder from the sidebar.
folders.deleteBlockedHasMaterials: Move or archive the materials inside first.
folders.confirmDelete: The folder will be archived. Its materials are kept; they just become Unfiled.
folders.nameTaken: A folder with that name already exists.

warehouse.noIssuances: No materials issued to this property yet.
warehouse.reverseIssuanceConfirm: Reverse this issuance? Stock will be restored and the property cost will be inverted.

field.name: Name
field.priceEditHelp: Affects future issuances only — historical costs keep the price snapshot from when they were issued.
field.initialQuantityHelp: If non-zero, recorded as a RECEIPT movement now.
field.unitPriceHelp: If provided, also updates the material's current price.
field.deltaHelp: Positive to add, negative to remove. Negative deltas cannot exceed on-hand stock.

closing.title: Close {{name}}
closing.description: Final audit: confirm handover, then the system generates the certificate and final report and archives the property.
closing.statusWarning: Status is {{status}}. Closing requires every MASTER sub-stage to be ACCEPTED.
closing.portfolioHelp: Upload at least one finished-state photo. These are stamped onto the handover certificate.
closing.checkMaterials: All construction debris cleared and material accounting reconciled (TZ 8.2).
closing.checkClient: Client handover walkthrough complete and acceptance signed.

templates.emptyDesc: Create your first template — start blank, copy the built-in ERP default, or clone an existing one.
templates.createDesc: Pick a starting point and give it a name. You can edit everything after creation.
templates.createBlankDesc: Empty template. Add stages and checklists manually.
templates.createFromErpDesc: Copy the built-in renovation template (8 stages, 90+ control points).
templates.createCloneDesc: Duplicate one of your templates as a starting point.
templates.createCloneUnavailable: No templates available to clone yet.
templates.deleteTemplateDesc: This permanently removes the template and all its stages, sub-stages, checklists, and media requirements. Existing properties created from this template are not affected.
templates.deleteStageDesc: This permanently removes the stage and all its sub-stages, checklists, and media requirements.
templates.deleteSubDesc: This permanently removes the sub-stage and its checklists and media requirements.

newPropertyWizard.title: New property
newPropertyWizard.pickTemplateHelp: Pick the pipeline this property should follow. You can tailor it in the next step before saving.
newPropertyWizard.noTemplates: No templates yet — create one before adding a property.
newPropertyWizard.tailorHelp: Optionally edit the snapshot of "{{name}}". Changes apply to this property only — the source template stays unchanged.
newPropertyWizard.createdNotice: Property created. Optionally attach a floor plan now, or skip and add it later.

masters.title: Masters
masters.description: Onboard with single-use invite links. The roster shows live ratings and availability.
masters.createInvitationDesc: Pick a role, optionally pin the email, set an expiry, and share the link.
masters.noInvitationsDesc: Pending invites will show up here.
masters.noMastersDesc: Send out invite links above to onboard your first masters.

rating.title: Performance
rating.noActivityTooltip: No resolved stages yet — rating unlocks after the first acceptance.

masterDetail.availabilityHelp: While the override window is active, notifications for new stages skip this master.
masterDetail.closingPermissionDesc: Grants the "Chief Technical Supervisor" role — an Inspector with this permission can sign off on the final acceptance and close a property. Master accounts can also receive it for flexibility, though only Inspectors act on it in practice.

finance.title: Finance
finance.description: Plan-vs-Actual across all properties. Net profit = planned − wages − costs.
finance.emptyDescription: Finance rolls up once properties enter the pipeline.

masterFinance.title: My balance
masterFinance.description: Earnings, fines and payouts. Owner marks payouts settled when paid.

settings.title: Company settings
settings.description: Currency, targets, branding and retention policies for this company.

currency.title: Currency & targets
currency.description: Display currency and the standard per-m² cost benchmark every property is held against.
currency.codeHelp: Only changeable when no non-archived properties exist.
currency.targetHelp: Per-m² cost benchmark. Properties at or below stay on-standard; over flags for review.

rating.title: Rating weights
rating.description: Balance how much a master's rating reflects their pace (actual vs standard stage duration) against their defects (rejection rate). The two sliders always sum to 2 — pulling one up pushes the other down. Equal at 1.0 / 1.0; set defect to 2.0 to rate purely on quality, or speed to 2.0 to rate purely on throughput.

branding.title: Branding
branding.description: How this company appears in shared UI.

retention.title: Retention
retention.description: How long photos and notifications stay around.

inspectorHome.awaitingDesc: Submitted by masters — tap to review.
inspectorHome.emptyDirectDesc: Initial property acceptances will land here.

inspectorStage.initialDesc: Upload "before" photos (meter readings, panoramas, riser condition) and confirm materials availability.
inspectorStage.needPhoto: Upload at least one photo to enable submit.
inspectorStage.slotMissing: Master did not upload media for this required slot.
inspectorStage.slotEmpty: No media uploaded for this slot.
inspectorStage.defectCommentPh: What's wrong, what needs to be redone
inspectorStage.overrideReasonPh: Why are you overriding the automatic flow
inspectorStage.fineAlreadyApplied: Fine already applied to the latest rejection.

masterHome.inProgressDesc: Stages you've claimed. Tap to upload photos.
masterHome.noClaimsDesc: Pick something from the Available list below.
masterHome.nothingAvailableDesc: New tasks will appear here when masters before you finish.
masterHome.reworkDesc: These stages were rejected by the inspector. Open each one to see what failed, then re-submit.

masterStage.needPhoto: Upload at least one photo to enable Complete.
masterStage.inspectorChecklistHint: Verify each of these before submitting. The inspector walks the same list.
masterStage.fixTheseItemsHint: The inspector will walk this same list on re-submission. Failed items are highlighted; passed ones don't need redoing.
masterStage.submittedNotice: Submitted for acceptance. Waiting for inspector review.
masterStage.rejectedActionHint: Fix the issues, upload new photos, and submit again.

procurement.title: Procurement (stub)
procurement.description: Role exists from Phase 1; UI deferred per assumption A1.

tenants.title: Companies
tenants.description: Provision new client companies, suspend, resume, or export their data.
tenants.emptyDescription: Provision your first company to get started.
tenants.suspendBody: {{name}} will be locked out until resumed. Their data is preserved.
tenants.provisionDesc: Sets up a fresh, isolated workspace for the company, seeds the default renovation template, and creates the first Owner account.
tenants.slugHelp: Lowercase letters, digits, hyphens. Used as the company's internal identifier.
tenants.defaultTemplateLanguageDesc: Language used for the default renovation template seeded into the new company.
